# SoundBank

[Toolkit](README.md) · `DotGame.Toolkit.Audio` · class

```csharp
public sealed class SoundBank : IContent
```

Types: [`IContent`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/IContent.md)

A loaded sound bank: one decoded buffer (held by the base [`Sound`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/Sound.md)) plus a set of named [`SoundSegment`](SoundSegment.md) cues that each describe a sub-range of that buffer.

## Remarks

The bank owns the base sound (and therefore its decoded audio). Disposing the bank disposes the base sound; the segments become invalid at that point and must not be played.
